test_title: PYST 76: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 29 Feb, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2defb073b34a52a472b181d735b0d570455859dca469dec5c715614a8f65a524.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

1) Minus sign element → Shift alternately two steps and one step anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11ad2de0c8ed72d81d3a4084e991ac7e3f9d4adaf15b2c2291eaa51a66379931.png] 

2) Divide sign element → Shift alternately one step and two steps anticlockwise subsequently.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11e81c7f85cc94b4387a3cbca5bd47cbaebba83d09c1a4ed4fd81940ed76b1e5.png] 

Thus, the final series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf3234eb0894f31b7f4135ef7476857bfd25ceac5387bd36424deb4d42cb4cf4.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
